blocks.orig: Tulia Zanzibar is a beautiful, spacious resort on the northeast coast of Zanzibar. As the name suggests (tulia means take it easy in Swahili) Tulia Zanzibar offers its guests a feeling of peace, with just sixteen villas spread over a huge garden along the beach. All spacious villas boast huge, comfy beds, a private terrace, AC and a luxury ensuite bathroom, set in a design that reflects the spirit of Zanzibar, with the use of lots of whites and natural woods. Some villas offer garden views, others look out of the ocean and some even boast their own swimming pool.
blocks.html: Tulia Zanzibar is a lovely, spacious resort on Zanzibar's northeast coast. True to its name (tulia is Swahili for take it easy), Tulia Zanzibar gives its guests a sense of calm, with only sixteen villas set across a large garden along the beach. Each spacious villa has a huge, comfortable bed, a private terrace, AC and a luxurious ensuite bathroom, in a design that captures the spirit of Zanzibar through plenty of white and natural wood. Some villas look out over the garden, others face the ocean, and some even have a swimming pool of their own.

blocks.orig: At Tulia you step into a world of luxury with personalized service tailored to individual needs, an à la carte all-inclusive dining concept, a wonderful swimming pool with two amazing slides for both young and old, and an exclusive spa. Last but not least, the resort has an impressive garden with more than 450 species of flowers and plants.
blocks.html: Staying at Tulia means luxury and personal attention, with service adapted to what each guest needs. Meals follow an all-inclusive à la carte concept, the lovely swimming pool has two great slides that children and adults both enjoy, and there is an exclusive spa as well. To top it off, the resort's impressive garden is home to over 450 different species of plants and flowers.
